title: Abductee Carol's missing pregnancy and her hybrid daughter
place_text: Her home and aboard a craft

plain: In the 1990s a woman named Carol said she had been abducted, taken from her home aboard a craft. The story goes that she lost a pregnancy and came to believe she had a hybrid daughter, part human and part alien. The lawyer Dan Sheehan passes this on second-hand. He says Carol was studied by the psychiatrist John Mack, and that she was "furious at the UFO people because she'd been abducted."
